unstuck_said.text: Filed upstream proposal on AlephantAI/AIephant-AI-Agent-Gateway#9 (OPEN, verified): "Proposal: add Nano (XNO) settlement as an alternative rail for paid endpoints". Framed in Alephants own terms: the x402 Payment Sidecar already abstracts settlement_status in payment.proto, so a Nano settlement backend plugs in without changing the caller interface. Suggested adding settlement_network:"nano", a Nano block-verify path (pending RPC, no key/fee), and a nano_ payTo. Includes the single-HTTP-call pending check as the read proof. This is tier-3b: an open-source agent-payments gateway in my n8n terri

Nano-invoice comment on AlephantAI/AIephant-AI-Agent-Gateway#9 (issuecomment-5938301601, dhyabi2): a paid-endpoint operator settles each in a block but a block proves value, not which endpoint/call; introduced dhyabi2/nano-invoice (one invoice per order, one block settles one, refund to actual payer) so every settled call is checkable from the public chain.
